events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: Free outdoor New York Transit Museum festival with historic and modern NYC buses, boarding opportunities, family activities and transit staff at Brooklyn Bridge Park.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, bus displays and activities are free.
events.caveats: Advance registration is encouraged but explicitly not required. Event runs rain or shine; buses/equipment are subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza. Walk-in admission is valid; optional advance registration enters guests in a museum-membership raffle.

events.brand: NYC Emergency Management × Staten Island Children’s Museum
events.address: Staten Island Children’s Museum, 1000 Richmond Terrace, Building M, Staten Island, NY
events.what_it_is: Family preparedness day with NYC agencies and community partners, including Ready Girl activities, bounce house, face painting, balloon art and emergency-preparedness resources.
events.what_is_free: NYC Emergency Management states that admission to the museum is free for this event.
events.caveats: No advance RSVP requirement is published on the current NYC Emergency Management listing.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–3 PM at Staten Island Children’s Museum, 1000 Richmond Terrace, Building M.

events.address: West 84th Street between Amsterdam Avenue and Columbus Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Free neighborhood resource fair connecting visitors with NYC agencies, community partners, services and information.
events.what_is_free: Public admission and access to the resource fair are free.
events.caveats: No advance registration requirement is stated on the current Manhattan Borough President listing.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–3 PM on West 84th Street between Amsterdam and Columbus.

events.brand: Queens Borough President × NYC Parks × Transportation Alternatives
events.address: Flushing Meadows Corona Park, Queens, NY
events.what_it_is: Inaugural free Queens community bike tour with 12-mile and 25-mile route options, followed by a festival with food vendors, performances, sponsor tables and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Bike-tour registration is free; the official page also advertises a post-ride festival and giveaways.
events.caveats: Advance registration is required and participation is capped at 2,000 riders. The official page currently says to register while spots are still available; availability can change as the cap is reached.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20 at 10 AM, rain or shine. Both routes start and finish in Flushing Meadows Corona Park; registered riders receive exact route details digitally.

events.event_name: 32nd Annual Mexican Independence Day Parade NYC
events.brand: The Mexican Parade Inc. / Comité Cívico Mexicano de NY
events.address: Madison Avenue from East 38th Street to East 27th Street, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Annual public parade celebrating Mexican Independence Day and Mexican heritage, culture, music, dance, art and community in Manhattan.
events.caveats: The current listing gives a noon step-off but does not publish a specific end time; no end time is inferred here.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20 at 12 PM. Parade steps off at Madison Avenue and East 38th Street and proceeds south to East 27th Street.
